success: requested target observed with at least two first-hit color rays, then home error <= 0.15 m; no fall, contact or safety stop; within the validated time budget
missing_blue_success: not_found with no claimed detection, then safe return within the validated time budget
freeze_rule: Freeze code and task plans before first held-out run. If changed after inspecting held-out results, disclose those seeds as development and select new held-out seeds.
known_limits: ideal 360 degree 1.8 m range and first-hit surface color sensor
